sources.text: Zheng Lab We are scientists in the Department of Neurosciences at UC San Diego studying why axons in the brain and spinal cord fail to regenerate after injury. Using genetically modified mice, we investigate the underlying mechanisms to help guide treatments for spinal cord injury, white matter stroke, and neurodegenerative diseases. Learn More Support Our Work Your donation helps drive discoveries in neural repair and regeneration. By funding our work, you contribute to developing therapies for spinal cord injury, stroke, and neurodegenerative diseases. HOW TO DONATE Team Find out more about our lab members and researchers.
